name: The St. Regis Sanya Yalong Bay Resort
positioning: St. Regis beach resort on Yalong Bay in Sanya, at the southern tip of Hainan, set between a marina and a protected mangrove forest
best_for: Beach lovers who want direct access to a long stretch of white sand on Yalong Bay
Families wanting a kids' club and pool activities for children
Groups or families looking at a two-bedroom seaside villa with its own pool

facts.text: The resort sits on Yalong Bay with access to more than 800 meters of white sandy beach.
Sanya is at the southernmost tip of Hainan.
The Tropical Paradise Forest Park is right at the resort's doorstep.
Social serves breakfast, lunch and dinner, with indoor and outdoor dining and live cooking stations.
The Drawing Room is an open-air restaurant and lounge in the resort's lobby.
The Sanya Mary is the hotel's take on the bloody mary, inspired by Hainan Island and made with ingredients sourced from the island.
St. Regis Butlers give guests one point of contact for their questions and needs.
The resort has outdoor tennis courts for guests.
The resort has a St. Regis Kid's Club.
A swimming pool bubble show for kids is held every afternoon.
Sailing excursions, kayak tours and snorkeling trips are offered.

highlights.text: The resort is surrounded by a marina and a protected mangrove forest.
Iridium Spa covers 3,500 square metres and offers massage therapies, body treatments, skin care and salon services.
The Royal Seaside Villa is a two-bedroom villa on the sea with its own pool and an outdoor dining gazebo.
Ming Xuan is the resort's modern Chinese restaurant, with views of the Yalong Bay Yacht Club, and Driftwood is its beachside restaurant for seafood and meats, with views of Yalong Bay.
The Decanter Wine Cellar features wines from around the world.

considerations.text: Sanya Phoenix International Airport is approximately 35 km from the hotel, and the hotel does not provide shuttle service.
Pets are not allowed at the resort.
WhataHotel notes that the remote tropical location requires travel planning.
